BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

Henry Charles Beeching, ed. (1859–1919).  Lyra Sacra: A Book of Religious Verse.  1903.

By Digby Mackworth-Dolben (1848–1867)

Requests

 
I 
ASKED
 for Peace,—

My sins arose

And bound me close,

I could not find release.

 

I asked for Truth,—
        5

My doubts came in,

And with their din,

They wearied all my youth.

 

I asked for Love,—

My lovers failed,
        10

And griefs assailed

Around, beneath, above.

 

I asked for Thee,—

And Thou didst come

To take me home,
        15

Within Thy heart to be.
